title: Finite coordinate expansion of the actual exterior Koszul differential
statement: For a finite list f over a commutative ring A, extend its actual exterior Koszul complex to nonpositive integer cochain degrees. Define exteriorKoszulBasis by the increasing-wedge basis and the extension coordinate, exteriorKoszulCoordinate by its dual basis projection, and exteriorKoszulCoefficient as the value at 1 of inclusion followed by the actual differential followed by projection. The differential on each basis inclusion is the finite sum of the target basis inclusions preceded by multiplication by these actual coefficients. The definitions use the constructed ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex boundary and do not assume any proposed formula for its entries. This has no site, realization functor, tower or duality.

source.place: Tags 0622 and 0664, ordered Koszul generators and the graded Leibniz rule; algebraization.tex, Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free duality.

proof.text: In each supported degree reindex the exterior basis by supported subsets. Transport the usual sum of coordinate projection followed by basis inclusion equals identity through extendXIso; unsupported terms are zero objects, where the same equality holds. Postcompose the actual boundary with this identity decomposition of its target. Every resulting A-linear endomorphism of A is multiplication by its value at 1. This proves the expansion in the explicitly defined actual coefficients, including empty index types and the zero ring.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0622 and 0664. F3 proves the generic finite basis identity and the matrix expansion of the actual constructed boundary in Lean; no contraction-sign formula is assumed or left as a hole here.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorKoszulBasis_d {A : Type w} [CommRing A]
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (q : ℤ) (I : exteriorKoszulIndex r q) :
    exteriorKoszulBasis r f q I ≫ (exteriorKoszulExtended r f).d q (q + 1) =
      ∑ L : exteriorKoszulIndex r (q + 1),
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mul A A (exteriorKoszulCoefficient r f q I L)) ≫
          exteriorKoszulBasis r f (q + 1) L
